# SEO & Performance Requirements Quality Checklist: Store & Workshop Platform

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of technical SEO, in-app caching, and performance requirements (Phases 17 & 18).  
**Created**: 2026-09-18  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (FR-053 through FR-061)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command as a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact.  
**Review Ownership**: Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all targeted search matching attributes (`name`, `sku`, `mpn`, `brand`, `shortDesc`) explicitly enumerated in the catalog search specification? [Completeness, Spec §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the specification define the fallback behavior when `getCachedCatalogMetadata()` encounters an unpopulated or unresponsive cache state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-053]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the exact client interactive routes requiring server `layout.tsx` wrappers exhaustively listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-059]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the specification define the minimum set of Schema.org properties required for the Najafabad `ElectronicsStore` entity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-060]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for zero-product state when navigating to an existing category landing page? [Completeness, Spec §FR-058]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the specification explicitly define the TTL (time-to-live) and on-demand invalidation triggers for catalog metadata? [Completeness, Spec §FR-053, §FR-057]

## 2. Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK007 Is the search query execution latency target quantified with an objective threshold (< 100ms)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the Vazirmatn typographic font configuration specified with exact numeric weights (`400`, `500`, `700`, `900`) and loading strategies? [Clarity, Spec §FR-056]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the geo-coordinates (`32.6365457, 51.3551911`) and landline phone (`03142626116`) for the Najafabad store unambiguously documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-060]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the canonical URL structure explicitly specified to prevent query parameter permutations from causing duplicate content penalties? [Clarity, Spec §FR-061]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the incremental static regeneration (ISR) interval for product detail pages quantified with a specific numeric second value (`300`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-053]

## 3. Requirement Consistency & Alignment

- [ ] CHK012 Do category URL paths in `src/app/sitemap.ts` (`/categories/[slug]`) perfectly match the route path defined in the category landing page requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-058]
- [ ] CHK013 Is domain resolution unified across all canonical links, OpenGraph tags, sitemaps, and robots declarations via `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-060]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the breadcrumb hierarchy definitions consistent between product detail pages (`Home > Catalog > Category > Product`) and category landing pages (`Home > Categories > Category`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-058, §FR-060]
- [ ] CHK015 Do administrative product and category mutation requirements trigger matching cache tag invalidations (`revalidateTag('catalog-metadata')`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-057]

## 4. Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements specified for invalid or non-existent category slugs in `/categories/[slug]` (e.g., standard `notFound()` triggering 404)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-058]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for multi-keyword search queries containing Persian half-spaces (ZWNJ), Arabic characters, or special punctuation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for dynamic metadata generation when multiple filter dimensions (category + brand + search query) are simultaneously active? [Coverage, Spec §FR-061]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the specification define whether the Chapter 13 Cable Calculator retains standalone tool routing or remains unified on the homepage anchor (`/#calculator`)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-060]
- [ ] CHK020 Are error resilience requirements specified if administrative revalidation hooks fail during offline database seeding or batch imports? [Coverage, Spec §FR-057]

## 5. Non-Functional Requirements & Web Vitals

- [ ] CHK021 Is the Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) optimization requirement specified with actionable attributes (`priority`, `loading="eager"`) for above-the-fold hero and product images? [NFR, Spec §FR-061]
- [ ] CHK022 Are database composite indexes specifically targeted to eliminate sequential table scans on high-traffic sorting combinations? [NFR, Spec §FR-054]
- [ ] CHK023 Does the specification mandate strict Persian RTL numeric isolation (`<bdi dir="ltr">`) for tracking codes, landline numbers, and postal codes across SEO views? [NFR, Spec §FR-060]
- [ ] CHK024 Are structured data JSON-LD schemas required to pass Google Rich Results Test validation without critical errors? [NFR, Spec §FR-060]
- [ ] CHK025 Is in-app memory caching specified without introducing external microservice dependencies (Redis / external daemon)? [NFR, Spec §FR-053]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after reviewer confirms the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a quality gate and does not modify markers.
- Items are numbered sequentially (`CHK001` - `CHK025`) for unambiguous traceability.
